assumptions.claim: entropy_ready_i is asserted only when the external EDN is ready to accept entropy requests.
assumptions.risk: If entropy_ready_i is falsly asserted or not properly maintained, entropy_req_o may be driven when EDN cannot accept, causing data loss or protocol violation.

assumptions.claim: When seed_update_i is asserted, seed_data_i holds a valid 32-bit seed value.
assumptions.risk: Driving seed_update_i with invalid or unstable seed_data_i could corrupt internal PRNG state, leading to compromised entropy quality.

assumptions.claim: wait_timer_limit_i set to 0 disables the timer; any other value must be accompanied by a valid wait_timer_prescaler_i to define timeout window.
assumptions.risk: Inconsistent or out-of-range timer configuration could either prevent timeout detection or cause false timeout, affecting system response to stuck conditions.

assumptions.claim: hash_cnt_clr_i is pulsed by external logic to clear the internal hash operation counter hash_cnt_o; afterward hash_cnt_o increments for each KMAC operation until next clear.
assumptions.risk: If clear is not executed when expected, hash_cnt_o may exceed hash_threshold_i, triggering false error or unintended state transitions.

assumptions.claim: entropy_req_o is acknowledged by entropy_ack_i in a standard request-acknowledge handshake.
assumptions.risk: Missing ack could lead to deadlock or starvation of entropy requests.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en_i indicates a fatal lifecycle error condition; the module must honor this signal by ceasing normal operation or entering safe state.
assumptions.risk: Ignoring lifecycle escalation could allow security-sensitive operations in a compromised or untrusted lifecycle state.

uncertain_points.claim: The exact arithmetic and comparison between hash_cnt_o and hash_threshold_i, and the precise effect of hash_cnt_clr_i, are not defined in this port list.
uncertain_points.risk: Misalignment in counter clearing or threshold comparison could cause functional errors in hash-rate limiting or security monitoring.

uncertain_points.claim: entropy_configured_o is a mubi4_t output, but no logic or documentation in this chunk explains when it is set or cleared.
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect configuration status reporting to system monitors could hinder error recovery or health checks.

uncertain_points.claim: The fast_process_i description implies complex control over rand_valid_o (garbage value when not processing Keyblock, never de-assert unless not KeyBlock) that depends on internal state not visible here.
uncertain_points.cond: when fast_process_i is active or mode_i indicates non-Keyblock processing
uncertain_points.risk: Misbehavior in rand_valid_o de-assertion logic could cause the entropy interface to stall or present stale data.
